title.narrative: Technical assistance in accounting and phasing out of emissions of GHG, ODS and F-Gases

description.narrative: The project is part of the EUR 10 million Climate Package for Sustainable Economy, the first cooperation programme related to the European Green Deal (EGD) and aimed to assist, at Government¿s, local and individual businesses¿ levels to ¿synchronise¿ with the EGD. Specific objectives: 1) Facilitate climate change mitigation policies through enhancing availability, reliability, quality and presentation of the country¿s GHG emissions reporting; 2)  Contribute to the phasing out of Ozone Depleting Substances (ODS) and further advancing climate change mitigation through preparing for gradual phasing down of hydrofluorocarbons (HFC) in the framework of Kigali Amendment to Montreal Protocol.

consistent with Public Administration Reform PAR principles

The IPA PF match is still valid. The SRC PAR covers the implementation period 2016 2020 previously extended for two years by Addendum 1 and 2 with a total value of EUR 63 Million complemented with technical assistance of 17 Million. The second addendum was introduced as a response to the COVID19 crisis by introducing an internal reallocation of funding from the undisbursed variable tranches to a new fixed tranche and for complementary technical assistance in order to use unspent funds to continue supporting public administration and public financial management reforms. Also an extension of the operational implementation deadline and the execution period of the Financing Agreement by 12 months was introduced to ensure the achievement of the results of the complementary assistance.In Serbia EU intervention is supporting via a sector budget support programme the national government to revise its PARPFM policy. The BS complementary support component of the programme amounts to EUR 17 million. It is implemented through five contracts 41 and ensures technical assistance to support the PAR and PFM areas to design guide coordinate monitor and report on the implementation of the reform agendas for the implementation of visibility and communication measures and for the assessment of the achievement of targets and indicators.
